overview_description: List, create, change, cancel and delete accounts, with their contacts, addresses, payment methods, notes and related records.
intro: Accounts are the customers and suppliers you bill and buy from. Here you create, read, change, cancel and delete accounts, manage their contacts, addresses, payment methods, billing preferences, notes, image and emails, and list the orders, invoices, payments and other records that belong to an account. This area has 65 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Purging an account removes it and its records permanently, and cannot be undone.**
notes: **Paths take the account's `id`, not its `uuid`.** The `id` is a short code such as `W13ZGY`; passing the `uuid` returns `404`.

**Most writes wrap their fields in one key.** Account writes use `account`, a single address `address`, a contact `contact`, a payment method `payment_method` and billing preferences `billing_preferences`. Setting a password and sending an email take their fields at the top level, and adding addresses takes a top-level `addresses` list.

**A contact is read by its slot and written by its id.** Retrieve a contact with its slot, `CONTACT_1` to `CONTACT_5`; update, replace and delete it with its `con_` id. A contact created as `CONTACT_1` reads back with `type` `billing`.

**Writes are flatter than reads.** `currency` and `time_zone` go in as a code and a name and read back as objects, an address is written with `post_code` and reads back with `postal_code`, and a contact's name is written as `first_name` and `last_name` and reads back under `name`.

**Many reads and every account write return the whole account.** The contacts, addresses, payment methods, billing preferences, inventories and partial invoice reads return the account under `account`, carrying the part asked for, rather than a paged listing.
**Paged listings use a cursor.** Records come under `data` with a `pagination` object; while `has_more` is `true`, pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to get the next page.

endpoints.title: List accounts
endpoints.summary: Lists your accounts a page at a time, with optional filters and sorting.
endpoints.description: Returns accounts under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Narrow the listing with `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>` for other tests, such as `filter_created_on_gte` or `filter_email_address_contains`. Every filterable field also takes `_neq`; the text fields take `_contains` and `_not_contains`, and `created_on` and `last_updated_on` take `_gt`, `_gte`, `_lt` and `_lte`. The primary contact filters as `filter_contact1_<field>` and a custom attribute as `filter_attribute_<name>`.

parameters.description: The most accounts to return on one page.

endpoints.title: Create an account
endpoints.summary: Creates an account and returns it under `account`.
endpoints.description: Send the account under `account`. `name` and `type` are required; `type` is `CUSTOMER`, `SUPPLIER` or `CUSTOMER_AND_SUPPLIER` and reads back in lower case. Fields are flat: `currency` is a code and `time_zone` a name. Contacts, addresses and payment methods can be added in the same call.

currency.description: The currency code. The default currency applies when omitted.

credit_limit.description: A decimal, as a number or a numeric string.

contacts.description: Contacts to add. Each needs a `type`.

state.description: The state's name, not an id.

country.description: The country's name, not an id.

addresses.description: Addresses to add, each written as in Add addresses to an account.

payment_methods.description: Payment methods to add, each written as in Add a payment method.

400.description: `name` or `type` is missing, or the body holds a key this call does not accept.

endpoints.title: Replace an account
endpoints.summary: Rewrites an account's fields and returns the account.
endpoints.description: Send the fields under `account`. `name` and `type` are required on every call. A field the body leaves out keeps its value. `status`, `addresses`, `payment_methods`, `grant_portal_access` and `grant_portal_password` are refused. A `contacts` entry with an `id` updates that contact; one without an `id` creates a contact and needs a `type`.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account's `id`, such as `W13ZGY`. Not its `uuid`.

currency.description: The currency code. The default currency applies when omitted.

credit_limit.description: A decimal, as a number or a numeric string.

id.description: A `con_` id. With it the entry updates that contact; without it a new contact is created, which needs a `type`.

200.description: The account, under `account`, with the change applied.

400.description: `name` or `type` is missing, or the body holds a key this call does not accept.

id.description: The short code every path takes, such as `W13ZGY`.

status.description: The account's status, in lower case, such as `active`, or `inactive` once cancelled.

type.description: The account type, in lower case, such as `customer`. It is written in upper case, such as `CUSTOMER`.

currency.description: The account's currency. Written as a currency code.

time_zone.description: The account's time zone. Written as a time zone name.

tax.description: The account's tax profile, or `null` when it has none.

image_url.description: Retrieve an account's image returns the image link instead.

addresses.description: The account's addresses. Retrieve an address returns one address object here instead of a list.

contacts.description: The account's contacts. Retrieve a contact by slot returns one contact object here instead of a list.

inventories.description: Returned by List an account's inventories.

partial_invoices.description: Returned by List an account's partial invoices from quotes.

payment_method.description: Returned by Retrieve a payment method.

AccountUser.description: The user who created or last changed a record.

AccountAddress.description: An address as it reads back.

AccountContact.description: A contact as it reads back.

type.description: What the contact's slot reads back as: `billing`, `shipping` or `primary`. A contact created in slot `CONTACT_1` reads back as `billing`.

name.description: The contact's name, split into parts. Written flat as `first_name`, `middle_name` and `last_name`.

AccountContactName.description: A contact's name as it reads back.

AccountContactPhone.description: A phone, mobile or fax number. All three share this shape.

AccountPaymentMethod.description: A payment method as it reads back.

default.description: Whether this is the account's default method. The first method added to an account becomes its default.

last_used_at.description: The time of the method's most recent charge, or `null` if it has never been charged.

AccountBillingPreferences.description: An account's billing preferences as they read back.

billing_start_date.description: An option such as `DAY_OF_MONTH`, not a calendar date.

charges_aligned_to_billing.description: Whether charges align to billing. This is the name the account read uses for the alignment setting.

charging_and_billing_alignment.description: The alignment setting under its written name. Written as a boolean, read as a string.

url.description: The path the listing came from, such as `/api/v4/accounts`.

AccountPagination.description: How to fetch the next page. A cursor listing sets `has_more` and `next_cursor`; an offset listing sets `records`, `offset` and `next_page`.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Rely on this rather than `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

records.description: The total number of matching records, not the length of the page.

next_page.description: On an offset listing, the literal string `NULL` at the end of the listing, not JSON `null`.

image_uri.description: A link to the image, not the image itself. `null` when no image is set.

AccountWithContact.description: An account whose `contacts` holds the one contact asked for, not a list.

AccountWithAddress.description: An account whose `addresses` holds the one address asked for, not a list.

content.description: The note's HTML, stored and returned as written.

AccountNoteAttachment.description: A file attached to a note. Address it by its `uuid`.

content.description: The note's HTML, stored and returned as written.

AccountNoteFile.description: A description of one attached file, not the file's contents.

AccountKpis.description: The account's revenue and order counters. Money values are strings, such as `0.00`.

AccountFinancialSummary.description: The account's name and its invoice totals.

AccountFinancialSummaryDetail.description: Invoice totals. Money values are strings.

AccountCustomObject.description: A custom object with this account's instances of it, which are paged inside it.

AccountCommunicationsEmail.description: An email sent to or from an account.

uuid.description: The value Retrieve an email and the email delete take.
